subject: Exec sign-off required: ApexCloud redlines on liability, indemnity, warranty
messages:
From: Kelsey Reardon <kelsey@apexcloud.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <mruiz@apexcloud.ai>, ApexCloud Procurement <procurement@apexcloud.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Revised contract redlines (liability / indemnity / warranty)

Soojin — thanks again for the demo last week. The team reviewed the contract and attached a marked-up set of redlines. High level asks from our side: 

- Increase liability cap to $10,000,000 (we need meaningful recovery for downtime)
- Broad indemnity for third-party claims related to data and regulatory fines
- Removal of broad warranty exclusions; we need a limited warranty that services will be "performed in a professional and workmanlike manner" for 12 months

We understand you have internal guardrails — we're flexible on some items if we can get the commercial terms aligned. Deal size: $1.2M ARR, 3-year term. Please route to legal/exec as needed — Marta and procurement are on copy. Redlines attached: ApexCloud_Redlines_v2.pdf, Apex_SOW_v3.docx.

Kelsey Reardon
Director, Strategic Procurement
ApexCloud

Subject: Fwd: Revised contract redlines (liability / indemnity / warranty) — exec sign-off request

Team — forwarding ApexCloud's redlines. Key commercial context: 3-year commitment, $1.2M ARR, strong strategic reference in cloud infra. They have pushed for a very high liability cap and broad indemnities. Legal, can you summarize risk and recommended counters?

Ask for leadership: if legal recommends an exception, we need an exec sign-off to accept modified cap/indemnity. Timebox: Apex wants an answer by end of week (Friday).

Quick summary for execs: 
- Customer requests cap = $10M (vs standard cap = aggregate of fees or $1M).
- Wants indemnity for regulatory fines arising from customer data processing.
- Wants warranty tightened to 12 months with service-level commitments and remedies beyond credits.

Attachments from Apex attached.

Next steps I propose: legal to recommend max allowable cap + carve-outs. Sales to provide value justification (strategic ref). Leadership sign-off if legal recommends > standard.

Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Revised contract redlines — risk assessment and recommended position

Team — reviewed the redlines and ran a quick risk analysis (see attached spreadsheet). Summary and recommended counters below: 

Summary of Apex asks:
- Liability cap: $10M across the board
- Indemnity: broad, includes regulatory fines and data-related third-party claims
- Warranty: 12 months, with a remedy that could include unspecified "repair" obligations and potential service credits beyond our standard SLA cap

Key legal risk:
- Unlimited or very large caps expose Redwood to disproportionate loss relative to the contract value ($1.2M ARR).
- Regulatory fines: we cannot accept indemnity for third-party regulatory fines (we are a processor in many cases). Exposure could be material and outside our control.
- Warranty language as redlined creates open-ended remediation obligations and could conflict with our operational model.

Recommended position (negotiation posture):
1) Liability cap: counter to a fixed-dollar cap of $3,000,000 aggregate for direct damages (this is above our baseline but contains exposure). Include carve-outs for gross negligence and willful misconduct (no cap).
2) Indemnity: accept indemnity for third-party IP infringement and claims arising from our gross negligence or willful misconduct. Do NOT accept indemnity for regulatory fines; instead, include mutual cooperation obligations and carve a statement that regulatory fines are only indemnified if caused by Redwood's willful misconduct.
3) Warranty: agree to a limited 12-month warranty that services will be provided in a professional manner and that material breaches will be remedied as set forth in the SLA. Retain a monetary cap on remedies (SLA credits only) and exclude consequential/diminution damages.

Escalation ask: Laura requests executive approval to make a one-time exception to standard cap limits up to $3M for this strategic account, conditioned on: 
- Customer providing evidence of insurance naming Redwood as an additional insured (or suitable commercial insurance)
- Legal to add explicit IP carve-outs and a mutual limitation of consequential damages clause

If leadership approves $3M with the above controls, legal will prepare redlined contract and SOW for signature and instruct sales to get a DocuSign routing. If leadership declines, we will counter with standard cap (fees or $1M) and hold commercial.

Attachment: Risk_Analysis_ApexCloud.xlsx (loss scenario modeling).

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Revised contract redlines — quick commercial note

Aditya — quick context for exec decision: this is a high-visibility cloud ISV reference (ApexCloud). Probable upsell in year 2 across two additional lines if we close. Customer has pulled forward implementation and is ready to sign if we land on cap/indemnity. 

If we can approve up to $3M with Laura's insurance and warranty carve-outs, we likely close this quarter (impact to FY26 bookings is material). If we hold to $1M cap, they will push to other vendors.

Would like your sign-off to approve legal's recommended exception (3M cap + insurance + IP carve-outs). If approved, Soojin will finalize the contract and get DocuSign out today.

Marissa Cole
Account Director, Strategic Sales
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0122

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Revised contract redlines — executive decision

Thanks team — and thanks Laura for the clear analysis. After weighing strategic value, expected ARR uplift, and our risk controls, I authorize the following one-time exception for ApexCloud: 

- Approve aggregate liability cap of $3,000,000 (direct damages only) for this agreement.
- Indemnity limited: Redwood will indemnify for third-party IP infringement and for damages caused by our gross negligence or willful misconduct. We will NOT indemnify for regulatory fines except where caused by our willful misconduct.
- Accept 12-month limited warranty language but preserve our SLA-based remedies and exclude consequential damages.
- Conditions: Customer must provide proof of commercial general liability and cyber insurance (minimum limits to be verified by Legal), and Legal to add explicit IP carve-outs and a mutual limitation of consequential damages.

Laura/legal: please produce the final redline and SOW reflecting the above and route via DocuSign. Soojin/Marissa: you have permission to move to signature subject to the legal edits and insurance confirmation. Thank you — let’s get this over the line.

Aditya Rao
VP, Revenue Operations
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

---Action items: Legal to redline (Laura). Sales to request insurance certificate and send DocuSign (Sojojin).
